alt.en: An arXiv submission reports strong results on existing benchmarks and a 52.7% proof rate on a harder sample built from implementations. The saved abstract supports reporting those claims, but does not independently validate them.
alt.zh: 一篇 arXiv 投稿报告了现有基准上的较高成绩，以及源自实际实现的更难任务样本上 52.7% 的数学证明成功率。保存的摘要记录了这些主张，但不足以独立验证结果。
